title: Hats for the valley
body: Word has reached us that you have done something worth a hat. We make them for folk who do. Ask at the hatter's counter on your achievements page, and you will find the first one waiting. Wear it well.

title: Thank you for the errands
body: Ten jobs off the board, and not one left to rot. The valley notices a helping hand. Here is a little something for your trouble.

title: Forty errands and counting
body: Forty requests filled. We hardly know how the valley managed before you. Please take this, and know that it is meant kindly.

title: A crown, and a lamp
body: The whole valley is tended, and word of it has reached our workshop. There is a hat waiting at the hatter's counter. With this letter comes a brass lamp from the lamp-makers, with a flame that holds steady through ash and wind. Hang it somewhere you will see it.

title: A pie for market day
body: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. Here is the pie I make when the shelves are full. Do not let the leeks go soft.

title: The hotpot
body: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. This one I keep for the cold evenings. I do not write it down for just anyone.

title: Tea from the back room
body: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. You asked about the tea I keep behind the counter. Here is how to start a bush of your own.

title: Pots for the greenhouse
body: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. The Larder is mended, and the glass wants something growing in it. A pot takes a little clay, some stone and a clear crystal. Here is how it is made.

title: Custard from the inn
body: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. The inn's custard, as promised. Two eggs, and patience.

title: My roast
body: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. The roast the inn is known for. Keep it in the family of friends.

title: Every fish on the line
body: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. Word came up the coast that you have landed every fish the valley holds. We have kept something back for such a day. It is an elderfruit, and it is yours.

title: A word about the hall
body: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. The next bundle the hall wants is the one you are closest to. Look at the board by the door, then come and tell me how it goes.
